Set rulebook-wide settings

Source: R/rulebook.R
set_rules.Rd

Set rulebook-wide settings

Usage

set_zone_map(rb, ...)

set_zone_families(rb, ...)

set_defaults(rb, ...)

set_morphology(rb, ...)

set_conversion(rb, x)

set_ground(
  rb,
  mode = c("most_restrictive", "with_access", "full"),
  overlap = NULL,
  parking_area_per_dwelling = NULL,
  outdoor_area_per_dwelling = NULL
)

set_variant_choice(rb, choice = "max")

Arguments

rb

A plancap_rulebook.

...

Named values. For set_zone_map(): zone code = zone key. For set_zone_families(): family name = character vector of zone keys. For set_defaults() and set_morphology(): names from rulebook_defaults() and morphology_defaults().

x

For set_conversion(): a conversion().

mode

For set_ground(): how the ground budget treats paving. "most_restrictive" (default; footprint is the least of coverage and what landscaping and impervious limits leave, assuming no paving), "with_access" (also deducts measured access legs and any parking and manoeuvring allowance) or "full" (also deducts outdoor space required per dwelling).

overlap

For set_ground(): named logicals saying which ground may count twice: outdoor_living_counts_as_landscaping, landscaping_on_structure, deep_soil_counts_as_landscaping.

parking_area_per_dwelling

For set_ground(): surface parking and manoeuvring area (m2) needed per dwelling in "with_access" and "full" modes.

outdoor_area_per_dwelling

For set_ground(): outdoor living space (m2) at ground per dwelling in "full" mode.

choice

For set_variant_choice(): "max" (default: each site takes the most enabling of its permitted alternative standards), "min", or the name of one variant.

Value

The updated rulebook.

Examples

rb <- rulebook("Exampleton District Plan") |>
  set_zone_families(RESIDENTIAL = c("LDR", "MDR", "HDR")) |>
  set_morphology(corner_angle_tolerance = 25) |>
  set_conversion(conversion(dwelling_size = 90))
rb$morphology
#> $corner_angle_tolerance
#> [1] 25
#>
